title: Amber Perfume Bottle on Travertine with Olive Branch
summary: A warm studio still life of an amber glass perfume bottle with a pale oval cap on a porous stone block, an olive branch and a blank folded card beside it.
mainPrompt: Studio still-life product photograph, landscape orientation, arranged along a soft diagonal that runs from the bottle at upper left down to the folded card at lower right. A single squat amber glass perfume bottle stands off-center left: rounded shoulders, sides tapering gently inward to a thick flat base, a liquid fill line about two-thirds up, glossy translucent dark-amber glass, capped by a matte pale greige oval stopper wider than the neck. Behind and to the right of the bottle lies one fresh olive branch, a thin woody stem with roughly twelve narrow silver-green leaves, laid nearly horizontal and sloping slightly down to the right. In the lower right foreground a blank cream folded card rests tent-style, slightly open, on the stone. The supporting surface is a cream travertine-like block with pitted pores and a straight chipped front edge crossing the lower left. A mottled pale grey-beige plaster wall fills the background. Soft directional daylight from the upper left rakes across the scene, throwing a long diagonal shadow to the right of the bottle and a warm amber caustic glow onto the stone beside its base. Warm neutral white balance with cream, amber and muted sage colors, fine photographic grain, matte stone and glossy glass highlights.
negativePrompt: text or print on the card or bottle, extra bottles, extra olive branches or leaves, harsh black shadows, cool blue or cyan cast, cluttered props, warped or asymmetric bottle silhouette, glossy reflective stone, fantasy or illustrated rendering
